description: This file defines the class tlAttachmentRepository, which manages storage, retrieval, and deletion of attachments in the TestLink project. It handles both filesystem and database repositories for attachments, including methods for inserting attachments, copying, deleting, and retrieving their content, as well as configuration management.

classes.name: tlAttachmentRepository
classes.description: A class that manages storing and loading attachments, supporting both filesystem and database storage backends, with methods for handling attachment CRUD operations, copying, and content retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository with database connection and configuration properties.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns the singleton instance of the repository.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the repository type configuration (e.g., filesystem or database).

methods.name: getCompression
methods.description: Returns the compression type used for attachments storage.

methods.name: getPathToRepository
methods.description: Returns the configured path to the filesystem repository.

methods.name: insertAttachment
methods.description: Inserts a new attachment into the repository, managing file storage and database record creation.

methods.name: buildRepositoryFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the full file path for storing an attachment based on table name and id.

methods.name: getFileContentsForDBRepository
methods.description: Reads and compresses file contents for storing in a database repository.

methods.name: storeFileInFSRepository
methods.description: Stores an uploaded file into the filesystem repository, handling compression if configured.

methods.name: buildRepositoryFolderFor
methods.description: Builds the directory path for attachment storage, creating directories if needed.

methods.name: deleteAttachment
methods.description: Deletes an attachment, both from filesystem and database.

methods.name: getAttachmentContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of an attachment, either from filesystem or database.

methods.name: getAttachmentContentFromFS
methods.description: Fetches attachment content directly from the filesystem, handling decompression if necessary.

methods.name: getAttachmentContentFromDB
methods.description: Fetches attachment content stored in the database, with decompression if applicable.

methods.name: createAttachmentTempFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file from base64-encoded content, returning file info.

methods.name: deleteAttachmentsFor
methods.description: Deletes all attachments associated with a specific object id and type, and deletes related directories.

methods.name: getAttachmentInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed info about a specific attachment record.

methods.name: getAttachmentInfosFor
methods.description: Fetches info for all attachments related to a specific object id and type.

methods.name: getAttachmentIDsFor
methods.description: Returns an array of attachment IDs associated with a specific object id and type.

methods.name: copyAttachments
methods.description: Copies all attachments from a source object id to a target object id, handling both filesystem and database backends.
